description: A friendly chibi caricature of a tall slim man in his late twenties: white baseball cap with monogram, sandy-blonde hair, light reddish-blonde stubble beard, blue heather crewneck sweatshirt with a cream-tan teddy bear graphic on the chest, charcoal slim chinos, and white low-top sneakers. Hands empty, no prop. Ships with 4 standalone pointing poses (right, left, up, down) for website use.
author: mario
